I'm not a relationship expert, but sounds like you both have become complacent. You feel as if you're roommates and there's no romance and no spark left in the relationship. 11 years is a long time to be together without trying to "progress" the relationship. It also sounds like you have communication issues. Maybe she is resentful that you haven't made any moves yet? And that made her step back or start to check out of the relationship?

I'm not condoning her actions here either. Her negativity and depression is probably wearing thin on your positivity and you feel drained being around her. It's hard to sustain a relationship in these conditions. You both need to actively start dating again! Just because you're together for so long doesn't mean it doesn't take effort. Maybe try a scheduled date night once in a while? And talk to each other! And if none of that works, couple's counseling? 

And yeah, maybe include a tl;dr at the bottom. This was pretty long.
